FAQ

Entry

A date I typed is not recognized

11/25/2026 is a text for DocCells. Type 2026-11-25, then choose the Date format (dates).

A number appears instead of a date

Dates are numbers of days: give the cells the Date format (Format › Number).

My numbers do not add up

Aligned left, they are texts. A unit typed in the cell, or a decimal comma, makes it a text (types).

The zero at the beginning of a number disappears

Give the Plain text format before typing, or start with an apostrophe (texts).

Numbers expect a comma instead of a point

DocCells follows the browser's language. ?lang=en sets it (language).

Formulas

#NAME? with TRUE or FALSE

Write TRUE() and FALSE(), or 1 and 0 (conditions).

#NAME? with a function suggested by DocCells

Not all suggested functions are computed (functions not computed).

IFERROR lets DIV/0 through

Test the divisor: =IF(B2, A2/B2, "") (errors).

Pasting does not keep my formulas

Paste of the right-click menu pastes the values; Ctrl V pastes the formulas (copying).

Writing the name of a month or formatting a number inside a text

The TEXT function is not computed: give a format to a separate cell.

Counting the checked boxes

=SUMPRODUCT(B2:B6, B2:B6) (checkboxes).

TODAY()+1 gives #VALUE!

Put =TODAY() in a cell and add to that cell (dates).

Presentation

The color of a cell does not change

The cell is in the range of a conditional formatting rule.

A button has disappeared

The window is narrow: it is behind .

Sorting or filtering is refused

The range contains merged cells: unmerge them.

Files

Saving downloads a new file

This is the case in Firefox and Safari. Chrome and Edge write to the file (saving).

The page closed without saving

Open DocCells again in the same browser: it offers to restore the copy (recovering).

My chart is not printed

Printing only shows the cells (printing).

A ?url= link does not open my workbook

The file's site may refuse to be read by other sites. A Google Sheet must be shared by link (sharing).

My links have disappeared

They are not saved in the Excel format (what is not kept).

Students

Can a student change the formulas?

Not in a protected workbook, outside the unlocked cells (protecting). Adding mode=student to the link removes the means of lifting the protection.
